title: Source-first page checklist gate
summary: This iteration binds the source-first public page structure into the deterministic daily page checklist, so source story, metrics, status focus, source map, and full inventory regressions fail the page quality gate.

lessons.lesson: Direct DOM assertions are not enough for scheduled page quality.
lessons.evidence: The red E2E removed `#section-source-signal-story` and `evaluateDailyPageChecklist` still returned `ok: true` before this phase.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep source-first DOM requirements inside `evaluateDailyPageChecklist` whenever they are required for public publish quality.

lessons.lesson: The source-first contract needs one blocking structural check with actionable details.
lessons.evidence: `source_first_public_contract` reports per-section card counts, stat/icon coverage, inventory row and finder state, and source-first ordering details.
lessons.recommended_action: Add future source-first structural requirements to this combined check instead of scattering them across unrelated content checks.

lessons.lesson: The full inventory must remain expanded even when the overview becomes card-based.
lessons.evidence: The new checklist requires 7 inventory overview cards, finder controls, and exactly 154 expanded inventory rows after the overview.
lessons.recommended_action: Preserve the overview-plus-expanded-detail pattern when refining source inventory density.

followups.action: After the next real daily run, review whether the source-first card text needs density tuning while keeping this checklist contract intact.
